_comment: Retail pricing rules mirrored from GP Rate Pro. Set enabled to true once the numbers are copied in (issue 11). percent and flat are added to carrier cost; price is a fixed retail price that ignores cost. A service entry beats a carrier entry, which beats default. Only add a carrier or service entry when it should differ from default. Example carriers: {"UPS": {"percent": 25, "flat": 1.5}}. Example services: {"USPS Priority Mail": {"price": 12.99}}.
